blocks.text: 55 questions: five from each of the 11 chapters, in a random order.

Your first answer to each question is the one that counts. 85% or better passes, and passing earns the badge for Nouns and Adjectives in Cases. You can take it as often as you like; the questions are dealt afresh each time.
